_comment: The 'mm' block for plugins/mm-grain/package.json. Plugins are NOT skills: skills teach an agent which mm commands to run, plugins add new commands to mm itself. Start from MetaMask/agent-wallet-plugin-template. Users consent to these capabilities at install time.
name: mm-grain
description: Verify and licence image provenance from the Grain registry on Monad.

mm._comment_capabilities: Keep the plugin-wide list EMPTY - it merges into every command. Declare per-command instead, so 'grain verify' asks for nothing.

commands._comment: requiresAuth = false in the command class. Works before sign-in - good demo beat.
The only command that moves money. Runs simulation -> Blockaid threat scanning -> policy. Monad mainnet 143 is Transaction Shield 'Covered', so scanning actually applies.

_note: The plugin system is still experimental. Document both config flags in the plugin README - judges who try it will hit them otherwise.
